population: all 9688 selected rational group-test rows from the 16 parent centered and shifted JSONL files, preserving arm, field, query, vector, curve, and point identity
quotient_certificate: At the first good, integral prime in the ordered list where P, Q, and P+Q all lie outside 2E(F_l), record Z-linear independence of their images in E(F_l)/2E(F_l). Keep every prime status tested before this hit.
rational_2_torsion_certificate: At the first good, integral prime in the ordered list with odd #E(F_l), certify no rational 2-torsion using good-reduction injection on prime-to-l torsion; l is odd. Keep no-hit rows unknown.
promotion_gate: A rational pair is certified independent only if both the quotient and no-rational-2-torsion certificates are present. Missing either remains unknown, not dependent.
falsifiers: a parent rational relation is certified independent
a quotient calculation disagrees with an independent exact group-law replay
parent row hash or count mismatch
measurement: exact arithmetic and coverage diagnostic on local host; no isolated wall-time comparison
